verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one URL per request (`r.jina.ai/<url>`). There is no batch submission endpoint, async job or polling API, or bulk-crawl capability for thousands of URLs. The search endpoint fetching its top 5 results, the S3 page cache and the self-hostable image are adjacent features or building blocks, not a batch-async scraping capability.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously
